# Community code of conduct

Epigraph is built through respectful, technical collaboration. Everyone participating in the repository is expected to:

- discuss ideas and code without attacking people;
- give specific, actionable feedback;
- respect privacy, attribution, and licensing;
- avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, and unwanted personal contact;
- keep security reports and private user data out of public discussions.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, issues, pull requests, or contributions that violate these expectations. Repeated or severe violations may result in temporary or permanent loss of participation access.

If a conduct concern cannot be handled safely in an issue or pull request, contact the repository owner privately through GitHub. Reports will be reviewed as confidentially as practical.
